display_long_description:
# Optimized for Meta Quest 3
Get the best experience on Meta Quest 3 with better graphics and more advanced physics simulation.

# Become a Slime Scientist
This is your own lab where all the slime-making happens. You’ve got everything you need to mix, stretch, and get creative. Combine ingredients to create your own slime from scratch. Experiment to find your favorite formula!
[media]

# Customize Your Slime
Slime can be anything you want it to be. Shape it into food, create slime pets, or make something entirely your own.
[media]

There are endless combinations!
- Play around with tons of colors
- Add charms, glow effects, and tweak the stickiness
- Melt it down or freeze it into a new shape

Whatever theme you're feeling, you've got the charms to match.
[media]

# Fulfill Customer Orders
Customers are counting on you! Match their orders as best you can, and see how your creations measure up.

# Run the Lab
Keep your lab stocked and running. Order supplies, upgrade your tools, and unlock new ingredients. The better your setup, the more you can create.
